title: MLBT Layer Data — Illustrative Schema
description: Public illustrative schema describing the structure of data exchanged between layers of the Multi-Layer Brain Twin (MLBT) pilot demo. This schema describes DATA SHAPE ONLY. It does not include the proprietary context-detection rules, layer-selection heuristics, correlation scoring, or cross-layer integration logic used by the confidential engine.

layer.description: Name of the biological layer this record refers to.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the event or observation.

state.description: Current execution state of the layer.

context.description: Free-text or identifier describing the query/context that triggered this layer's activation. In the pilot demo this is a placeholder string; the real engine's context-detection logic is confidential.

input_data.description: Placeholder container for layer-specific input data. Structure is illustrative only — actual field sets used in production are not disclosed.

output_summary.description: Placeholder container for the layer's contribution to the unified response. Real scoring, correlation, and integration values are not included in this public schema.

metadata.description: Optional non-sensitive metadata (e.g., schema_version, source system identifier).
